limitations: Environment readiness does not establish simulator physical validity or policy performance.

Three CFSDS train day-pairs have been converted and replayed without interventions. All overpredict daily growth and touch the crop boundary; a fourth geometric candidate was rejected at the nonfuel/water check. Suppression status is unknown.
TASK-004c cumulative-damage and terminal-reason handling remains required before the main policy benchmark.
The 44 compact-crop candidate list is a preliminary up-to-five-per-year screen, not exhaustive or a frozen benchmark.
2019/2024 Canadian FBP fuel map vintages and event-level suppression/QC evidence are needed before heldout runs.
Modern package freeze is macOS ARM64/Python 3.12 only; it is not a Colab/Linux lock.
Open-Meteo free API output requires attribution and is intended for non-commercial use; source is reanalysis rather than fire-local station data.
EFFIS fuel raster is NFFL/Anderson and 250m; current Firehose Cell2Fire build is Canadian FBP, so it is not a direct fuel input without selecting a compatible spread model or validating a crosswalk.
The FireSpread_MedEU v2 Zenodo record displays no clear data-package license; do not redistribute or assume the article license applies to the archive.
Docker apt dependencies are not version-pinned; current image digest pins this built image, but future rebuilds can resolve newer Debian packages.
